Thanks again for the demo last week. We'd like to move forward with a hands-on POC kickoff to validate routing behavior and run a small-scale load test against our critical prompt flows. High-level ask:

- 2 hour working session (30m prompt review + 90m live load test)
- Run routing scenarios that exercise prefix caching and failover to a lower-cost model

We were hoping to schedule the kickoff in the week of June 7. A couple constraints on our side: our ML lead is only available between 11:00–16:00 EDT.

I've attached a short questionnaire (acero-prelim-questionnaire.pdf) that outlines data flows and network constraints. Can you propose 2-3 slots? Also, if you have a short load-test plan we can review in advance that would be great.

Cheers,

Thanks for the heads up Lina — no problem. We can absolutely be flexible. Given the preferences you listed, two practical approaches:

1) Full 2-hour session (preferred if you have the folks available): Thu Jun 11, 11:00–13:00 EDT. We'll do:
   - 11:00–11:30: prompt set review and routing policy walk-through (KV cache priming)
   - 11:30–13:00: staged load test (warmup, ramp to target concurrency, sample analysis)

2) Split sessions: Wed Jun 9 14:00–15:00 EDT (prompt + routing) and Thu Jun 11 11:00–12:00 EDT (load test).

Load-test details (short):
- Target concurrency: 500 simulated clients for validation, with an option to ramp to 2k if the warmup looks stable
- Token caps: 512 token max per request for the test prep; sample set will include 6 prompts you provide
- Failure handling: we'll route failed calls to a lower-cost model variant (auto-fallback) so the user-facing service stays up
- Observability: we'll publish token-level latency and error-rate breakdown in the Console during the run

We can throttle ramp speed and abort early if error rates exceed 5% sustained for 2 minutes. Marissa will lead the run; Ethan will verify routing policy and KV priming. Vivek will stand by to inspect infra metrics.

If you confirm Jun 11 11:00–13:00 EDT I'll send the final calendar invite and a 24h reminder. Also please attach the 6 prompts in the shared Drive link (or paste them in the thread).

Best,
Kimberly
